Amendment to Territorial Jurisdiction of the Batangas Port Zone
(BPZ). The territorial jurisdiction of the Batangas Port Zone is hereby delineated as
A parcel of land described under SK-04-000016-12. Bounded on the SE.,
& NE., along lines 1-2-3 by Cad-264, Batangas Cadastre; on the SE.,
SW., NW., & NE., along lines 3-4-5-6-7 by Batangas Bay; on the NW.,
NE., & SE., along lines 7-8-9-10-11-12-13-14-15-1 by Cad-264, Batangas
Beginning at a point marked "1" on the plan being S. 81 deg. 29'55" W.,
1,587.654 m. from BLLM No. 1, Cad-264, Batangas Cadastre, thence:

Energy Projects Zone. Portions of the BPZ under EO Nos. 385 and
431 which are excluded under Section 1 of this Order is hereby segregated and reserved
for energy projects as identified by the Department of Energy and are excluded from the
administrative jurisdiction of the Philippine Ports Authority, consistent with existing laws
and regional industrial plans for the development and utilization of the said areas as
Energy Projects Zone.

Separability. Should any provision of this Order be declared invalid or
unconstitutional, the other provisions unaffected thereby shall remain valid and subsisting.

Repeal. All orders, proclamations, rules, regulations, or parts thereof,
which are inconsistent with any of the provisions of this Order are hereby repealed or
modified accordingly.

Effectivity. This Order shall take effect immediately upon publication
in a newspaper of general circulation.
DONE, in the City of Manila, this 25th,
, in the year of Our Lord,
Two Thousand and Fourteen.
By the President:
PAQUITO M/OCHOA, JR.
Executive Secretary
